skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understand the basic theoretical knowledge about actuarial pricing
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the concepts, characteristics, scientific foundations in the process of calculating insurance premiums, assumptions applied when pricing.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understand the basis of actuarial pricing for life insurance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Comprehend the principles and bases of actuarial pricing for life insurance, factors constituting the premium of each type of life insurance product.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Calculate premiums for some basic life insurance products
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply formulas and assumptions to calculate premiums for some types of life insurance products.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understand the principles and bases of actuarial pricing for non-life insurance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Grasp the principles and bases of actuarial pricing for non-life insurance, methods and formulas for calculating premiums for some basic non-life insurance products.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Calculate premiums for some basic non-life insurance products
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply formulas and assumptions to calculate premiums for some types of non-life insurance products.
Demonstrate the ability to work independently and in groups, logical thinking and critical thinking, legal awareness, and responsibility towards society.
